scope: Dedicated source-owned per-face eye_bag_preserve effect recovery using existing delta attenuation and immutable vector assets, actual full-source mixed-graph before/after, explicit confirmation and canonical history/export. Not request cancellation, automatic anatomy or new algorithm count.

integration_map.target: effect_recovery_state and facial_wrinkle_recovery target registry, availability and immutable per-face support assets
integration_map.render: existing people_effects source-frame target-only delta attenuation and common sampler unchanged; people_export dynamically strips canonical face targets from legacy global application
integration_map.review: eye_bag_effect_recovery stages append-only support into full_candidate_render; exact source/repair/graph/owner fingerprints rechecked on presented/prepare/commit
integration_map.native: effect_recovery_host requires full-source-render-srgb8 for this target; source capture, delivered/presented and one-use commit ownership retained
integration_map.ui: existing source capture painting with explicit final eye-bag review confirmation, target-specific quality validation and stale image callback guards
integration_map.history: canonical people graph vector reference and existing request receipts/history/export/project assets; no competing store or source overwrite

limitations: Manual anatomy remains partial; no segmentation/model/AI parity claim.
Recovery painting uses bounded authenticated source capture, not native eye-crop editor; full-source before/after reduced to RGB8 display.
Existing opaque SDR and memory/codec bounds retained; no alpha/HDR clipping or broad format acceptance.
Generic recovery preview cancellation discards unpublished authority but does not immediately interrupt an in-flight full render.
Active preset/batch/cohort transfer and complete shared-alias/dormant affected-set review remain guarded.
Existing uint8 recovery coverage is retained, not advertised as floating-point mask precision.
All tests/build/typecheck/product execution/imports/inference/downloads and runtime/native/UI/history/numerical/photo acceptance UNRUN.
